parts.text:
## 1. Enhancement Summary

Added **Predict a Specific Movie** below the existing Top-5 cards in `/home/dastan/Recommender Systems/Week 3`.

It uses the existing active-user dropdown, adds an unseen-movie selector and **Predict Rating** button, and displays both CF predictions to three decimal places.

## 2. Files Modified

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | Added prediction section; connected user changes to movie-selector refresh |
| `script.js` | Added movie-selector population, control states, and `predictSelectedMovie()` |
| `style.css` | Extended existing styling to the new controls and prediction cards |
| `browser-verification.js` | Extended real-Chrome checks for the new workflow |
| `movie-prediction.test.js` | **New:** focused prediction, consistency, regression, and integrity tests |

All changes are within Week 3. No external dependencies were added.

## 3. Existing Top 5 Behavior Preserved

The original workflow remains:

**Select User → Get Recommendations → User-Based Top 5 + Item-Based Top 5**

- Existing controls and both panels remain.
- Ranking and prediction algorithms were unchanged.
- Users 1 and 33’s lists match their saved Step 3 results exactly.
- Browser checks confirmed single-movie prediction leaves the existing Top-5 cards unchanged.

## 4. Movie Selector Implementation

Added `#movie-select`:

- Uses the existing `#user-select` as the only active-user selector.
- Initializes after loading and refreshes on user changes.
- Includes only movies with an unrated matrix cell for that user.
- Sorts by ascending movie ID.
- Displays existing parsed titles and stores movie IDs as option values.
- Clears previous movie selection and prediction output on user changes.
- Is disabled without a valid user.
- Shows **No unseen movies for this user** when appropriate.

Chrome verified **1,410 unseen options for User 1** and **1,658 for User 33**, with exact option-set comparisons against the rating matrix.

## 5. User Based Single Movie Prediction

The UI calls the **existing, unchanged** `predictUserBasedRating()`.

It retains:
- User/movie validation and rejection of already-rated movies.
- Existing weighted common-rating similarity.
- Top 20 positive neighbors.
- Contributions only from neighbors who rated the target.
- Active-user mean plus weighted neighbor deviations.
- `null` when no prediction evidence exists.

## 6. Item Based Single Movie Prediction

The UI calls the **existing, unchanged** `predictItemBasedRating()`.

It retains:
- User/movie validation and rejection of already-rated movies.
- Target-item observed mean as baseline.
- Comparisons against the active user’s rated movies.
- Signed similarity contributions in the numerator.
- Absolute similarities in the denominator.
- `null` when no prediction evidence exists.

Both UI outputs use **Insufficient collaborative evidence** instead of displaying `null`, `undefined`, `NaN`, or `Infinity`. Predictions remain unclipped.

## 7. Consistency With Top 5 Scores

For **Users 1 and 33**, tests checked every entry in both methods’ Top-5 lists:

- Single prediction matches the list score within `1e-12`.
- Repeated predictions are exactly identical.
- Scores are finite.
- Complete lists match saved Step 3 lists exactly.

This covers **20 Top-5 entries** across two users and two methods.

## 8. New Tests Added

`movie-prediction.test.js` contains **9 passing groups** covering:

- Dataset, README, and saved Step 3 artifact integrity before and after testing.
- Invalid users and movies.
- Already-rated movie rejection.
- Top-5 regression and single-score consistency for Users 1 and 33.
- Repeated-input determinism.
- Supported predictions for User 1/movie 512.
- Unclipped out-of-range prediction.
- Zero-overlap predictions returning no evidence.

Expanded Chrome checks cover unseen-only options, user-change refresh, three-decimal rendering, empty states, no-evidence messages, and preservation of Top-5 cards.

## 9. Existing Tests Re Run

Before editing:
- `bun verification.test.js`
- `bun browser-verification.js`

After editing:
- `bun verification.test.js`
- `bun movie-prediction.test.js`
- `bun browser-verification.js`

## 10. Exact Test Results

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Existing implementation suite before enhancement | **34/34 groups passed** |
| Existing browser verification before enhancement | **Passed** |
| Existing implementation suite after enhancement | **34/34 groups passed** |
| New movie prediction suite | **9/9 groups passed** |
| Expanded real-Chrome verification | **Passed** |
| Normal browser console errors | **0** |
| Dataset and README integrity | **Passed** |
| Saved Step 3 result-artifact integrity | **Passed** |

No full Step 3 evaluation or benchmark was rerun.

## 11. Real User/Movie Example

| Field | Result |
|---|---|
| User ID | **1** |
| Movie ID | **512** |
| Title | **Wings of Desire (1987)** |
| User had already rated it? | **No — matrix cell is 0** |
| User-Based prediction | **4.96454866430897** |
| User-Based displayed value | **4.965** |
| Item-Based prediction | **4.247308314123525** |
| Item-Based displayed value | **4.247** |
| User-Based sufficient evidence | **Yes** |
| Item-Based sufficient evidence | **Yes** |

Movie 512 is **#1 in User 1’s User-Based Top-5 list**. The single prediction equals that list score exactly. It is not in User 1’s Item-Based Top 5.

## 12. Browser Verification

Performed in real headless **Chrome 153.0.8010.36**, using local HTTP at a **1280 × 900** viewport.

Verified:
- Normal data loading and existing user selector.
- Get Recommendations and both five-item lists.
- New movie dropdown and Predict Rating action.
- Movie options refresh when switching users.
- Already-rated movies excluded.
- Both predictions rendered to three decimals.
- An above-5 prediction displayed without clipping.
- Existing Top-5 cards unchanged after prediction.
- No-user, no-unseen-movies, and insufficient-evidence states.
- Controls remain disabled on the deliberate data-loading failure.
- **Zero normal console errors.**

## 13. Dataset Integrity

Both datasets and `readme.md` have identical before/after hashes.


## 14. Known Issues

No new defect was found in the executed checks.

Existing algorithm behavior remains: some unseen movies lack collaborative evidence, and supported predictions may fall outside 1–5. The UI handles both explicitly.

## 15. Whether Step 3 Results Remain Valid

**Yes.** Similarity, support weighting, neighbor selection, prediction formulas, and Top-5 ranking remain unchanged. Saved Step 3 result artifacts were preserved and their recorded hashes passed integrity checks.

The historical Step 3 source hashes describe the pre-enhancement UI version; `script.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css` now include this enhancement. That provenance distinction does not require repeating the algorithm experiments.

No report was drafted or rewritten.
